script.spoken: El Faro sank in Hurricane Joaquin. The ship sank, and all thirty three crew were killed. Its route kept it close to the hurricane's path. Some weather updates it relied on were hours old. Water came in through an open hatch, and the ship listed. Then the engine lost oil pressure and stopped. Without power, the waves took over. Rules on weather routing and old ships were tightened.
